loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: Policy-required new_session/context_refresh boundaries should be executed by the agent/adapter automatically when host capabilities allow, without asking the user to paste or press Enter on a command.
If host limitations prevent automatic session creation/reset, CodeWiki must record a precise platform block/fallback instead of presenting the compatibility command as normal user work.
Workflow efficiency must be a roadmap success criterion measured by fewer user interrupts, fewer manual commands, shorter closure path, clear finish reports, and bounded loop/session/write cost.
Session automation and workflow-friction reduction take priority over TASK-001 decision_build implementation until the next roadmap alignment says otherwise.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Automatic boundary requirement is in system API/agency/compiler policy.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/api.md, .codewiki/kb/system/agency.md, and .codewiki/kb/system/compilers.md now state that normal workflow must not ask users to submit compatibility commands; unsupported paths record platform-limited fallback/next safe action.

.codewiki/kb/system/agency.md and .codewiki/kb/system/compilers.md now require workflow-efficiency evidence such as user interrupts, manual command count, session boundaries, and platform-limited steps.
TASK-005 was refined to high priority with session-boundary automation and workflow-efficiency acceptance, ahead of TASK-001 decision_build implementation.
